faq.question3: Can I modify server settings and configurations?

minecraftServerTypes.title: What Types Of Minecraft Servers Can I Run?
minecraftServerTypes.paragraph1: Our Minecraft hosting supports a wide range of server types for both Minecraft Java Edition and Minecraft Bedrock Edition, also known as Pocket Edition or Windows Edition.
minecraftServerTypes.paragraph2: Using our Game Panel, you can easily install and switch between server software such as Vanilla, Paper, CraftBukkit, Forge, Fabric, Spigot, and Sponge, along with performance-focused forks like Purpur, Pufferfish, and Folia. Proxy and network software including Velocity, BungeeCord, and Waterfall are also supported.
minecraftServerTypes.paragraph3: For Bedrock Edition, we support Bedrock Dedicated Server, PocketMine-MP, and NukkitMP, enabling cross-platform play across mobile, console, and Windows devices. Java and Bedrock players can also play together simultaneously using the GeyserMC plugin.
minecraftServerTypes.note: All server types and software versions can be changed at any time directly from the Game Panel in a single click.
